goal: Replace the wallet's custom WalletLogPrintf() with the new LogInfo/LogWarning/LogError macros, using a wallet-specific log context to keep the [wallet name] prefix.
Makes -logsourcelocations work for wallet log lines and lets wallet code use proper log levels instead of one flat level.

result.summary: Removes the wallet's custom WalletLogPrintf() helper and replaces it with the standard LogInfo/LogWarning/LogError macros, using a new WalletLogContext class that automatically prefixes log lines with the wallet name. It is built on top of two other open PRs (#29256 log context support, #34778 macro rewrite) and includes those commits in its diff. The change also fixes several places where wallet code was logging at the wrong severity (info vs warning vs error).
result.problem: Wallet code previously used a bespoke WalletLogPrintf() that always logged at info level and used its own call-site tracking, so -logsourcelocations and level-based filtering did not work for wallet logs, and severity was often mislabeled. Users and developers debugging multi-wallet setups or filtering logs by level are affected.

result.card: This PR removes the wallet's custom WalletLogPrintf() and switches wallet code to the standard LogInfo/LogWarning/LogError macros via a new WalletLogContext that preserves the [wallet name] prefix, also fixing several places where log severity was wrong (info instead of warning/error). It solves a debugging pain point: wallet logs previously couldn't use -logsourcelocations or level-based filtering. Strongest evidence of value is reviewer engagement itself: hodlinator, maflcko, and adyshimony all found and got fixed real issues (misclassified log levels, a dangling-reference hazard in the underlying log.h rewrite), and adyshimony gave an ACK once the lifetime issue was resolved. It is a draft explicitly stacked on two other open PRs (#29256, #34778) and flagged Needs rebase, so it cannot be merged or fully reviewed as a standalone unit until those land. The bulk of its size and risk (log.h/logging.cpp rewrite) belongs to those base PRs rather than to the wallet-specific commits unique to this one.
